mapper.select: SELECT * FROM tb_variable_version WHERE variable_code = #{variableCode} AND isactive = 1 ORDER BY version_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT v.* FROM tb_variable_version v INNER JOIN (SELECT variable_code, MAX(version_number) version_number FROM tb_variable_version WHERE isactive = 1 GROUP BY variable_code) latest ON latest.variable_code = v.variable_code AND latest.version_number = v.version_number WHERE v.isactive = 1 AND (v.variable_code LIKE #{pattern} OR v.variable_name LIKE #{pattern}) ORDER BY v.variable_code ASC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT variable_code, MAX(version_number) version_number FROM tb_variable_version WHERE isactive = 1 GROUP BY variable_code) latest INNER JOIN tb_variable_version v ON latest.variable_code = v.variable_code AND latest.version_number = v.version_number WHERE v.isactive = 1 AND (v.variable_code LIKE #{pattern} OR v.variable_name LIKE #{pattern})
